name: Orangetown Shopping Center
summary: Orangetown Shopping Center is a 76,334 square foot community center in Orangeburg, NY, anchored by CVS and Old World Food Market. Strategically located near three colleges, the center attracts over 1.2 million annual visits from a diverse mix of students, families, and specialty food shoppers.
demographics: Orangetown Shopping Center serves a diverse suburban community in Rockland County, New York, with a strong family-oriented demographic base. The trade area includes students and faculty from nearby Dominican College, St. Thomas Aquinas College, and LIU Hudson, creating a mix of young adult and traditional family shoppers. The center attracts middle to upper-middle income households typical of the Orangeburg area, with visitors seeking convenient access to everyday necessities and specialty grocers. Shopping patterns reflect a community-focused customer base that values quality food options and essential services, with the Old World Food Market drawing ethnic and specialty food shoppers from across the region.
description: Orangetown Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located on Orangeburg Road in Orangeburg, New York, serving the vibrant Rockland County area. Spanning 76,334 square feet, this open-air center combines essential retail services with specialty shopping options, anchored by CVS Pharmacy and the popular Old World Food Market, which draws customers seeking international and specialty foods. The center's strategic location near three major colleges—Dominican College, St. Thomas Aquinas College, and LIU Hudson—creates a dynamic mix of student, faculty, and residential traffic, generating over 1.2 million annual visits. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, Orangetown Shopping Center benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in the property. With convenient access, ample parking, and a tenant mix focused on daily needs and specialty offerings, the center has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping hub for the greater Orangeburg community.
